changelog:
Initial release of hiapi-seedance-2-0-video.

- Generate videos using HiAPI’s Seedance 2.0 model via the unified async task API.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video (first/last frame), and multimodal reference material.
- Flexible control over video duration (4–15 seconds), resolution (480p, 720p, 1080p), and aspect ratio.
- Handles audio generation, prompt-based configuration, and optional reproducible generation with seeds.
- Includes detailed error guidance and strict mode separation for input references.
